title: common@1 shared definitions (creature stat blocks, ids)
description: Shared $defs for monster@1 and character@1. Immutable once released (ARCHITECTURE.md §3.2). All numbers are integers (§4.3).

saving_throws.description: Total save bonus for each proficient save only (SRD stat-block convention).

skills.description: Total bonus for each proficient skill only.

class_name.description: SRD 5.1 class (same list as character@1 classes[].class).

speed.description: Speeds in feet (multiples of 5; 1 tile = 5 ft).

trait_active.description: A trait whose effect is mechanically applied by the engine (character@3+). Same shape as trait, but the effect must satisfy the kind-tagged effect contract.

effect_descriptive.description: Effect object as accepted by common@1 trait (character@1/@2, monster@1/@2). For character@1/@2 it is an inert description: the engine migrates it with an 'inert' marker and never applies it, because those stat blocks already bake the numbers in. Monster traits are applied by the engine (not gated yet). The validator checks known kinds against $defs/effect (errors for monsters, warnings for character@1/@2). 'inert' is reserved for the engine migration and must never be authored.

effect.description: Machine-readable feature effect, tagged by kind (contract: docs/CONTENT_EFFECTS.md). The engine FeatureRegistry maps kind to a hook. Unknown kinds are allowed: the validator warns and the engine reports them as unsupported and ignores them. Known kinds have their fields checked below. The object stays open (no additionalProperties: false), so v1 remains append-only and extra fields are ignored by the engine.

kind.description: Hook id. Known: damage_bonus, bonus_action_grant, self_heal, damage_mitigation, magic_weapons, multiattack, reroll_ones, great_weapon_fighting, evasion, pack_tactics, aggressive, reckless_attack, metamagic, sculpt_spells, font_of_magic.

then.description: Static: adds amount to the damage bonus of every attack action matching condition (every attack if condition is omitted). Applied when the archetype is built; content damage stays base damage.
Static: the creature may take each listed action as a bonus action (e.g. Nimble Escape).

actions.description: rules5e ActionKind ids grantable as bonus actions.

then.description: Static: declared multiattack options (SRD Multiattack). Each option is an ordered list of the creature's own attack action ids made with one Attack action; the AI and Command pick one by id. Use `options`, or the shorthand `attacks` for a single option named 'multiattack'. Attack ids that match no attack action are an engine load error.
Active (rules5e UseFeature): the user regains dice + plus hit points; limited to uses per recharge.

plus.description: Flat bonus added to the roll: an integer, 'level' (total level) or '<class>_level' (that class's level, e.g. fighter_level).

uses.description: Uses per recharge (uint8); 0 or omitted = unlimited.

then.description: Static: qualified resistances / immunities (SRD 'from nonmagical attacks', '... that aren't silvered / adamantine'). Plain, unqualified defenses stay in damage_resistances / damage_immunities.
Static (Magic Weapons): every attack of the creature counts as magical, so it bypasses 'nonmagical' resistance and immunity.
Static (R-G7, Halfling Lucky): a natural 1 on the listed d20 rolls is rerolled once and the new roll is used. Several declarations OR together.

rolls.description: Which d20 rolls: attack rolls, ability checks, saving throws. Omitted = all three. Repeats are allowed (OR).

then.description: Static (R-G7, Fighting Style): weapon damage dice of a two_handed melee attack, or a versatile melee attack held in two hands, that show 1 or 2 are rerolled once. No parameters.
Static (R-G7, Rogue / Monk Evasion): a Dex save against an effect that deals half on a success deals none on a success and half on a failure. No parameters.

Static (T&C-G7, SRD Pack Tactics): advantage on the creature's attack rolls against a creature when at least one of its allies that is not incapacitated is within 5 ft of it. No parameters; a second declaration adds nothing.

Static (T&C-G7, SRD orc Aggressive): as a bonus action the creature can Dash, and the movement past its own speed must take it toward a hostile creature it can see. No parameters; a second declaration adds nothing.

Static (T&C-G7, Barbarian Reckless Attack / SRD berserker Reckless): on its first attack of a turn the creature can choose advantage on Strength melee weapon attack rolls that turn; attack rolls against it then have advantage until its next turn. No parameters; a second declaration adds nothing.

Static (R-G14, Sorcerer Metamagic; sim #143): the creature knows the listed Metamagic options and pays them in sorcery points from the resources[] pool `pool`, which must be a limited pool of this document (load error otherwise). Several declarations add options and must name the same pool. The caller picks one option per cast (ActionRequest::metamagic).

options.description: Known Metamagic options (rules5e kMeta* bits). A repeat adds nothing (validator warning).

pool.description: resources[].id of the sorcery-point pool (a limited pool: not unlimited at the document's level).

then.description: Static (R-G14, Evocation Wizard Sculpt Spells; sim #143): when the creature casts an evocation spell (spell@1 school evocation) the caller may name creatures spared from its area (ActionRequest::spared). No parameters; a second declaration adds nothing.

Static (VERSION_BUMP_BATCH 7.2o, Sorcerer Font of Magic; sim #152): the creature's sorcery points are the resources[] pool `pool` (the same pool as metamagic.pool when both are declared; different pools are a load error), resolved by the sim to max = start = sorcerer level (classes[] sorcerer entries; 2+ required, load error below) with recharge long_rest, and it may use Flexible Casting (rules5e FlexibleCasting, a bonus action). The pool must not be unlimited (load error). Validator warning when the pool's max is not the sorcerer level, its recharge is not long_rest, or resources[] lacks it (the sim then registers it).

qualified_damage.description: Damage types that are resisted / immune only for a qualified source: nonmagical = any nonmagical attack; nonmagical_not_silvered = nonmagical and not silvered; nonmagical_not_adamantine = nonmagical and not adamantine.

effect_cost.description: Action-economy cost of using an active effect; omitted = action. Engine v0 implements action and bonus_action; reaction is reserved.

effect_condition.description: Named predicate over an attack action (FeatureRegistry conditions). one_handed_melee_no_other_weapon: melee_weapon_attack without the two_handed property (v0 wield model). melee_weapon: kind melee_weapon_attack. ranged_weapon: kind ranged_weapon_attack.

range.description: [normal, long] range in feet (SRD range 80/320 = [80, 320]); targets beyond normal and up to long range are attacked with disadvantage.

damage.description: BASE damage: weapon die + ability modifier (+ magic bonus). Never fold feature bonuses (e.g. Dueling +2) in; feature effects such as damage_bonus are applied by the engine.

qualifiers.description: monster@3 / character@3: what the weapon is made of / counts as, for qualified resistances (nonmagical, silvered, adamantine). Inert in earlier versions.

presentation.description: Presentation-only references; never read by rules5e adapters (§5.4).

spellcasting.description: monster@3 / character@3 only (engine-minimal; Tools & Content owns the final shape). Slots, caster level, ability and the spells the creature can cast now (known or prepared; cantrips included). Referenced spells must be spell@1 documents of the loaded pack set.

slots.description: Spell slots per spell level, keys "1".."9".

pact.description: Pact Magic: slots all of one level, restored on a short rest.

stat_block.description: Fields shared by monsters and characters.
